### 1\. Obtain your API key

First, you’ll need to generate a unique API key from your account dashboard.

1\. Navigate to the [API Dashboard](online.seranking.com/admin.api.dashboard.html) . You can access this by clicking the **API** icon in the main left-hand navigation menu:

2\. On the API Dashboard, click the **\+ CREATE API KEY** button located in the top-right corner:

3\. In the **Create API key** dialog box:

a. Enter a descriptive name in the **API key name** field (e.g., “Demo”).

c. Click **CREATE KEY** .

4\. Your new key will be generated and listed in the **API Keys** table. You can create multiple API keys for different applications or environments:

### 2\. Authenticate your requests

You have two methods to authenticate your requests. We strongly recommend using the Authorization header.

#### **Method 1: Authorization header (recommended)**

Include an `Authorization` header in your request, with the value `Token YOUR_API_KEY` .

You can test your key by fetching your subscription details. The `200 OK` response confirms that your key is working correctly.

Copy

```
curl -X GET 'api.seranking.com/v1/account/subscription' \  

  -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY'
```

#### **Method 2: Query parameter**

Alternatively, you can pass the key as a URL query parameter named `apikey` .

Copy

```
curl -X GET 'api.seranking.com/v1/account/subscription?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY'
```

## Making requests

Once authenticated, you can make requests to any API endpoint.

* **GET requests** can include parameters in the URL’s query string.
* **POST requests** must include the `Content-Type: application/json` header and send data in a JSON body.

**Example POST request**

Here is an example of a more complex POST request to the `/backlinks/summary` endpoint. Notice how the authentication header remains the same.

Copy

```
curl -X POST 'api.seranking.com/v1/backlinks/summary' \  

  -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY' \  

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  

  -d '{  

    "target": "seranking.com",  

    "mode": "host"  

  }'
```

## Postman collection

We offer a Postman collection to help you get started without writing any code. Postman is a free application that makes it easy to explore and test APIs.

### Prerequisites

* [Postman](getpostman.com/downloads/)
* [SE ranking account](seranking.com/sign-up.html)

### Getting started

To get started, click the **Run in Postman** button below. This will fork both the API collection and the environment template into your Postman workspace in one simple step.

When you click the button, you’ll be prompted to fork the collection. Enter a name for your fork and select the workspace where you want it to be created.

The pre-configured environment will also be forked into your selected workspace, ready for you to add your API key.

### Set your API key

To run requests, you’ll need to supply your [secret API key](online.seranking.com/admin.user.settings.api.html) and set it as an [environment variable](learning.postman.com/docs/sending-requests/variables/) within your workspace.

1\. To set any environment variable, create a new environment within Postman:

2\. Add your secret key as a variable to the environment and save:

3\. Set the environment to active:

4\. Now, within the collection, set it to use the environment you just created:

If your environment is set up correctly, you should see your secret key value if you mouse over the `secret_key` variable in the **Token** field:

5\. Be sure to save the collection after you’ve set the key:

results.title: SE Ranking MCP: Setup & Configuration
excerpts:
[Go to MCP Hub →](help.seranking.com/hc/en-us/categories/29433347957660-MCP-Hub)

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model to access your SE Ranking and SE Visible data simply and securely.

MCP server server follows the authenticated remote MCP spec, so it’s centrally hosted and managed. Connect in one click in [Claude](claude.ai/customize/connectors/id/se-ranking) or [ChatGPT](chatgpt.com/plugins/se-ranking) , natively in Cursor and other clients, or use the `mcp-remote` module for clients that don’t support remote servers.

## What you can access

Through the MCP server, your AI assistant can work with data from these SE Ranking and SE Visible products\*:

* [Data API](seranking.com/api/data/) : keyword research, backlinks, domain analysis, SERP, and more
* [Project API](seranking.com/api/project/) : your projects, rank tracking, audits, and competitors
* [Local Marketing API](seranking.com/api/local-marketing-api/) : your locations, local rankings, Google Business Profile, business listings, and reviews
* [SE Visible API](seranking.com/api/se-visible/) : your AI visibility projects, brands, topics, prompts, and sources

\*The data available to you depends on your subscription. Not every API endpoint is available through MCP. Setup is the same for every product. Use your SE Ranking account, or an API key generated in the API Dashboard of your SE Ranking or SE Visible account.

## Setup Instructions

### General

Our MCP server supports Streamable HTTP transports. This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication at the following address:

Copy

```
api.seranking.com/mcp
```

Jump to your client: Claude · ChatGPT · Codex · Cursor · VS Code · v0 · Windsurf · Zed · Gemini CLI · Others .

### Sub-accounts

If you’re a sub-account on a shared SE Ranking workspace, the **Sign in with SE Ranking** button won’t connect any tools. API access lives with the master account, not with sub-accounts. Sub-account API keys are on the way; until they’re released, use the workaround below.

To connect a sub-account:

1. Get the **API key** from your account administrator.
2. In the connection dialog, choose **Enter API keys manually** .
3. Paste the key when prompted.

## Claude

### **Claude (Web & Desktop)**

Add the official [SE Ranking connector](claude.ai/customize/connectors/id/se-ranking) and click **Connect** . In Claude Desktop, you can also find it under **Customize → Connectors** by searching for _SE Ranking_ .

[SE Ranking connector in Claude's connector directory](claude.ai/customize/connectors/id/se-ranking)

> 

### Claude Code

Two options. Pick one.

**Option A: OAuth (recommended)** — opens a browser on first connect, stores the token locally, and reuses it across sessions.

Copy

```
claude mcp add --transport http se-ranking api.seranking.com/mcp
```

Then run `/mcp` once you’ve opened a Claude Code session to go through the authentication flow.

...

Copy

```
claude mcp add --transport http se-ranking api.seranking.com/mcp \  

  --header "X-Api-Key: *****"
```

Grab the key from the API Dashboard in your SE Ranking or SE Visible account. Available tools depend on your subscription.

## ChatGPT

Open the official [SE Ranking plugin](chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a0b262d5c0c8191953dd94ba05412e2) , click **Install plugin** , and sign in to authorize. You can also find it in ChatGPT under **Plugins** by searching for _SE Ranking_ .

[SE Ranking plugin in ChatGPT](chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a0b262d5c0c8191953dd94ba05412e2)

## Codex

The setup steps for the MCP server are the same regardless of whether you use the IDE Extension or the CLI since the configuration is shared.

**Configuration via CLI:**

Run the following command in Terminal:

Copy

```
codex mcp add se-ranking --url api.seranking.com/mcp
```

This will automatically prompt you to log in with your SE Ranking account and connect it to your Codex.

...

Copy

```
[features]  

experimental_use_rmcp_client = true
 [mcp_servers.se-ranking]  

url = "api.seranking.com/mcp"
```

3\. Run `codex mcp login se-ranking` to move through the authentication flow.

...

Copy

```
{  

  "mcpServers": {  

    "se-ranking": {  

      "url": "api.seranking.com/mcp"  

    }  

  }  

}
```

Cursor supports Streamable HTTP and OAuth natively. An OAuth window will open on first use to authenticate with your SE Ranking account.

## Visual Studio Code

Copy

```
{  

  "mcpServers": {  

    "se-ranking": {  

      "command": "npx",  

      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "api.seranking.com/mcp"]  

    }  

  }  

}
```

1\. `Ctrl+P` / `Cmd+P` and search for **MCP: Add Server** .

...

Copy

```
npx -y mcp-remote api.seranking.com/mcp
```

4\. Enter the name `SE Ranking` and hit enter.

...

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "se-ranking": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "api.seranking.com/mcp"]
    }
  }
}

Yes, at the `api.seranking.com/mcp` endpoint. **Can I authenticate with my own API key?**

Yes. Instead of using the interactive authentication flow, you can pass your API key in the `X-Api-Key` header. See Claude Code, Option B for an example. This works well for headless environments, CI runners, and shared dev boxes.

A key passed this way has the same access as your account. Restricted or read-only API keys aren’t available yet. **No tools appearing after connecting?**

* Verify your SE Ranking or SE Visible account has API access at the API Dashboard.
* Run `/mcp` in Claude Code to check live connection status.
* Try removing and re-adding the server.

If you need further assistance, contact us at [api@seranking.com](mailto:api@seranking.com) .

* * *

excerpts:
**One key, both APIs.** A single API key authenticates every endpoint across the Data API and the Project API. There is no separate “Data key” and “Project key”: you generate one key and use it everywhere. What you can call depends on your plan, not on the key. Data API requests draw on your credit balance, while Project API requests use your subscription limits.

This guide explains the requirements and steps to gain access to both.

## Data API

The Data API provides direct access to SE Ranking’s extensive databases. Usage is billed in API credits, and every current subscription plan includes a monthly credit allowance.

### Credits included with your plan

All Essential, Pro, Business, Core, Growth, and Enterprise plans include Data API access with a monthly credit allowance:

|Plan |Included API credits (per month) |
| --- | --- |
|Essential |10,000 |
|Pro |25,000 |
|Core |25,000 |
|Business |100,000 |
|Growth |100,000 |
|Enterprise |100,000 |

### Need more credits?

If your monthly allowance runs out or you need more volume, you can add credits in any of these ways. Add-ons and the standalone plan are billed annually only; pay-as-you-go packs are a one-time purchase:

* **Pay-as-you-go (PAYG):** Credit packs that never expire. From $50 for 250,000 credits, with no limit on how many you buy.
* **API add-on:** Add credits to any subscription plan. From $540 per year (effective $45 per month) for 3 million credits.
* **API standalone plan:** Access SE Ranking datasets without the web application. From $2,148 per year for 12 million credits.

You can purchase or upgrade these options on the [Subscription page](seranking.com/subscription.html) .

...

### Subscription requirements

The Project API is available on every current subscription plan: Essential, Pro, Business, Core, Growth, and Enterprise. There is nothing extra to buy. Your Project API usage draws on the limits already included in your plan, such as the number of projects, tracked keywords, and audits.

You can monitor your subscription limits under **[Profile & Preferences > Billing](online.seranking.com/admin.subscription.html#/)** .

## Generate your API key

Once your account meets the requirements above, generate a key from your dashboard. The same key works for both the Data API and the Project API, so you only create it once.

1\. Navigate to the [API Dashboard](online.seranking.com/admin.api.dashboard.html) . Click the **API** icon in the main left-hand navigation menu, then select **Dashboard** .

2\. Click the **\+ CREATE API KEY** button located in the top-right corner.

3\. In the **Create API key** dialog box:

a. Enter a descriptive name in the **API key name** field (e.g., “Demo”).

b. Click **CREATE KEY** .

4\. Your new key will be generated and listed in the **API Keys** table. You can create multiple API keys for different applications or environments.

## Custom and enterprise solutions

If you have high-volume data needs exceeding standard plans or require a custom API solution, contact our team to discuss enterprise options, custom rate limiting, and pricing. You can reach us at [api@seranking.com](mailto:api@seranking.com) .

## Using your API key

Your API key is a secret token used for authentication. **Keep it secure and do not expose it in client-side code or public repositories.**

To authenticate your requests, include the API key in the `Authorization` header of your HTTP requests, using the `Token` scheme.

**Example (cURL):**

Copy

```
curl  - X  GET  "api.seranking.com/v1/backlinks/summary?target=yourdomain.com" \
      - H "Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY"
```

3. Getting Started with SE Ranking's API

Getting Started with SE Ranking's API

The API package is available as a standalone product — no active SE Ranking subscription is required. Start with a 14-day trial that includes 100,000 free API credits .
Paid plans include monthly Data API credits for testing: Core (25,000/month), Growth & Enterprise (100,000/month).
Legacy v7 plans: Essential (10,000/month), Pro (25,000/month), Business & Enterprise (100,000/month).
Legacy v1-v6: Essential and Pro plans do not include API access. To use the API, please purchase the API add-on.
Getting Started Troubleshooting More Resources
The SE Ranking API helps you work directly with SE Ranking's SEO data. With it, you can:
* Access keywords, competitors, backlinks, audits, AI Search , and Project Management API
* Connect SE Ranking data to your own tools
* Automate reports and scale workflows
The Data API and Project API are unified under a single API key. One key provides access to both Data and Project endpoints through the same api.seranking.com gateway.
API-only interface
If your account has a standalone Data API license, it automatically gets the streamlined API-only interface. When you sign in, you go straight to the API Dashboard, and the left-hand menu shows only the API section: the API Dashboard, Wallet (main accounts only, where available), and MCP.
Use the API Dashboard to create your API key and see your remaining credits, including Wallet credits. Use the Wallet to top up your API credits.

Getting Started

Step 1: Open the API Dashboard

1. Sign in to your SE Ranking account.
2. Select API in the left-hand menu to open the API Dashboard. If your account has a standalone Data API license, the API Dashboard opens automatically when you sign in.
api-dashboard-steps.png

Step 2. Generating an API key

API key – a single key that provides access to both raw SEO data (backlinks, domains, keywords, AI Search, audits) and project management endpoints (projects, ranks, audits, competitors).
1. Click Create API Key . (If the button is unavailable, you'll need to activate the API add-on first.)
2. Copy the generated key and store it securely. The same key authenticates calls to both Data and Project endpoints.
create-api-key.png create-api-key-modal.png api-key-created-modal.png api-keys-table.png

Step 3. Set Up Postman

1. Open the SE Ranking Postman Collection and import it into your workspace.
2. Fork the environment template.
3. In the environment settings, paste your API key under secret_key_data .
4. Save and set this environment as active.
Data API_EN_03.png Data API_EN_04.png Data API_EN_05.png

Step 4. Make your first Request

1. In Postman, go to Account & system > subscription .
2. Click Send .
Data API_EN_06.png
You should receive your subscription details in the response. Once this works, you can start exploring other endpoints like Backlinks , Keyword Research , Domain Analysis (including AI-Overview endpoints), or the Project endpoints (projects, ranks, audits, competitors) — all reachable with the same key.

# Getting started

## API access and keys

In order to use the API, it is necessary to have an API key from the SE Ranking user account. The API key must be transferred via the token parameter for each invoked method or via the Authorization HTTP header.

If an API method is invoked without an API key, or if an invalid API key is transferred in the request, the server returns a “no token” or “incorrect token” error.

**One key for both APIs.** A single API key authorizes every endpoint across the Project API and the Data API. There is no separate “Project key” and “Data key”: you generate one key and use it everywhere. What you can call depends on your plan, not on the key. Project API requests use your subscription limits, while Data API requests draw on your credit balance.

**Finding your API key**

**_Eligible accounts receive a API key automatically._** _In most cases, your key already exists and is ready to use._ To find it:

2\. Go to **API** \-> **[Dashboard](online.seranking.com/admin.api.dashboard.html)** .

3\. Your API key will be listed in the API Keys table. Copy it and use it in your requests.

## Making requests

The API is accessible via the HTTPS protocol. All API method invocations are HTTP GET/POST/PUT/DELETE requests to the URL:

Q

## Is the API pay-per-use or prepaid?

A

Both, depending on the plan. Pay as you go is a one-time top-up: buy any credit pack, use it whenever you need it, and the credits never expire. Annual plans are billed upfront for the year, which is what makes the discounted rate possible, up to 57% lower than Wallet.

A

Yes. The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as MCP server access. You also get access to the complete SEO and GEO suite by SE Ranking. No credit card required.

On annual plans, credits are provided upfront for the billing cycle and expire at the end of it. Unused credits don’t carry over to the next cycle. On Wallet, the balance is fully cumulative. Every top-up adds to your total with no expiry.

# SEO API: Automate your SEO and AEO workflows

Connect via API for custom integrations and bulk processes, or via MCP to query data from inside Claude or any AI assistant. Or do both.

Start free trial

No credit card required

## The data your workflows will run on

5.5B

Keywords database

100%

Accurate keyword rankings

188

Country database

25.5M+

AI prompts tracked

2.2B

Domain profiles

## Choose how to put SE Ranking’s API to work

Pick a workflow that fits your priorities and follow it straight through

### Know exactly where competitors outrank you across search and AI

Analyze any domain's performance, identify top competitors, a
...
Analyze domain and brand performance across leading LL
...
tes new SEO and AEO/GEO data daily, with a database that employs in-depth tracking to cover global and local search results. It also uses a vast link index to provide accurate data on backlinks.

Show more

Show less

Q

## What are the limitations?

A

A few things worth knowing before you integrate. SE Ranking doesn’t currently offer first-party SDKs and integration is done via the REST API reference and a Postman collection for endpoint testing. Also, default requests-per-second limits are lower than some competitors’, though these can be increased by contacting the support team. If you’re migrating from another API provider, you’ll need to remap your endpoints

Show more

Show less

Q

## How do I access SE Ranking's API?

A

Accessing our API is straightforward. Just log in to your SE Ranking account, navigate to the API tab under the Settings section, and retrieve your unique API key. Once you have your API key, you can use it for different purposes. For more information, refer to our API documentation.

Show more

Show less

Q

## How do I get an SE Ranking API key?

A

AP is included with every SE Ranking subscription. To get your key, log in to your SE Ranking account, go to the API section. From there, you can copy your API key and use it to integrate SE Ranking’s data into your applications, dashboards, or reports.

Show more

Show less

Q

## What is the cost of API access?

A

API access comes with any SE Ranking plan (Core at $129/mo and Growth at $279/mo). You can even test it in the free trial account. For higher volume, the API Add-On starts at $149/month and can be added to any existing subscription. Pay-as-you-go is also available with a $50 minimum deposit.

Show more

Show less

Q

## Can I use this API without technical expertise?

A

Yes, you don’t need a development team to use the SE Ranking’s API. One method is to run a pre-written code in Google Colab to gather data, then apply specific formulas within Google Sheets to clean the results. Use our code as an example and adjust it as needed. MCP is another path. Once connected, you can query keyword rankings, backlink data, site audit results, and AI search visibility directly from Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI assistant in plain language. No code required.

Show more

Show less

Q

## What is an MCP server?

A

MCP is a bridge between AI models like Claude and external tools, data sources, and services. SE Ranking’s MCP server connects SE Ranking’s data directly to AI assistants like Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and any other client. Once connected, you can query keyword rankings, backlink data, site audits, AI search visibility, and more in plain language, without switching between tools or writing code.

Show more

Show less

Q

## How does MCP differ from the API?

A

API and MCP server serve different use cases. The API gives you programmatic access to SE Ranking’s data for building custom integrations, automated workflows, and data pipelines. The MCP server is for querying SE Ranking data conversationally from inside an AI assistant. You can run research, analyses, and AI-assisted workflows without switching context. Both are included in every SE Ranking plan.

Show more

Show less

# MCP Server Documentation

New to SE Ranking MCP? What it does, pricing and use cases

New · MCP Hub

Explore the MCP Hub

Whether you’re connecting MCP for the first time or building advanced workflows, the MCP Hub brings every useful resource into one place, so you can start simple and level up at your own pace.

 Go to MCP Hub →

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model to access your SE Ranking and SE Visible data simply and securely.

MCP server server follows the authenticated remote MCP spec, so it’s centrally hosted and managed. Connect in one click in Claude or ChatGPT, natively in Cursor and other clients, or use the `mcp-remote` module for clients that don’t support remote servers.

## What you can access

Through the MCP server, your AI assistant can work with data from these SE Ranking and SE Visible products\*:

* Data API: keyword research, backlinks, domain analysis, SERP, and more
* Project API: your projects, rank tracking, audits, and competitors
* Local Marketing API: your locations, local rankings, Google Business Profile, business listings, and reviews
* SE Visible API: your AI visibility projects, brands, topics, prompts, and sources

\*The data available to you depends on your subscription. Not every API endpoint is available through MCP. Setup is the same for every product. Use your SE Ranking account, or an API key generated in the API Dashboard of your SE Ranking or SE Visible account.

## Setup Instructions

### General

Our MCP server supports Streamable HTTP transports. This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication at the following address:

Copy

```
https://api.seranking.com/mcp
```

Jump to your client: Claude · ChatGPT · Codex · Cursor · VS Code · v0 · Windsurf · Zed · Gemini CLI · Others.

### Sub-accounts

If you’re a sub-account on a shared SE Ranking workspace, the **Sign in with SE Ranking** button won’t connect any tools. API access lives with the master account, not with sub-accounts. Sub-account API keys are on the way; until they’re released, use the workaround below.

To connect a sub-account:

1. Get the **API key** from your account administrator.
2. In the connection dialog, choose **Enter API keys manually**.
3. Paste the key when prompted.

## Claude

### **Claude (Web & Desktop)**

Add the official SE Ranking connector and click **Connect**. In Claude Desktop, you can also find it under **Customize → Connectors** by searching for *SE Ranking*.



### Claude Code

Two options. Pick one.

**Option A: OAuth (recommended)** — opens a browser on first connect, stores the token locally, and reuses it across sessions.

Copy

```
claude mcp add --transport http se-ranking https://api.seranking.com/mcp
```

Then run `/mcp` once you’ve opened a Claude Code session to go through the authentication flow.

**Option B: API key** — skip the OAuth flow and pass your key as headers. Right for headless environments, CI runners, shared dev boxes, or when the browser handoff is awkward.

Copy

```
claude mcp add --transport http se-ranking https://api.seranking.com/mcp \  

  --header "X-Api-Key: *****"
```

Grab the key from the API Dashboard in your SE Ranking or SE Visible account. Available tools depend on your subscription.

## ChatGPT

Open the official SE Ranking plugin, click **Install plugin**, and sign in to authorize. You can also find it in ChatGPT under **Plugins** by searching for *SE Ranking*.

## Codex

The setup steps for the MCP server are the same regardless of whether you use the IDE Extension or the CLI since the configuration is shared.

**Configuration via CLI:**

Run the following command in Terminal:

Copy

```
codex mcp add se-ranking --url https://api.seranking.com/mcp
```

This will automatically prompt you to log in with your SE Ranking account and connect it to your Codex.

Paid plans include monthly Data API credits for testing:

(25,000/month),
Business & Enterprise (100,000/month).

*Legacy v1-v6: Essential and Pro plans do not include API access. To use the API, please purchase the API add-on.*

Getting Started  
Troubleshooting  
More Resources

---

The SE Ranking API helps you work directly with SE Ranking's SEO data. With it, you can:

* Access keywords, competitors, backlinks, audits, AI Search, and Project Management API
* Connect SE Ranking data to your own tools
* Automate reports and scale workflows

The Data API and Project API are unified under a single API key. One key provides access to both Data and Project endpoints through the same `api.seranking.com` gateway.

**API-only interface**

If your account has a standalone Data API license, it automatically gets the streamlined API-only interface. When you sign in, you go straight to the API Dashboard, and the left-hand menu shows only the API section: the API Dashboard, Wallet (main accounts only, where available), and MCP.

Use the API Dashboard to create your API key and see your remaining credits, including Wallet credits. Use the Wallet to top up your API credits.

### **Getting Started**

#### Step 1: Open the API Dashboard

1. Sign in to your SE Ranking account.
2. Select **API** in the left-hand menu to open the API Dashboard. If your account has a standalone Data API license, the API Dashboard opens automatically when you sign in.

#### Step 2. Generating an API key

**API key** – a single key that provides access to both raw SEO data (backlinks, domains, keywords, AI Search, audits) and project management endpoints (projects, ranks, audits, competitors).

1. Click **Create API Key**. *(If the button is unavailable, you'll need to activate the API add-on first.)*
2. Copy the generated key and store it securely. The same key authenticates calls to both Data and Project endpoints.

#### Step 3. Set Up Postman

1. Open the SE Ranking Postman Collection and import it into your workspace.
2. Fork the environment template.
3. In the environment settings, paste your API key under **secret\_key\_data**.
4. Save and set this environment as active.

#### Step 4. Make your first Request

1. In Postman, go to **Account & system > subscription**.
2. Click **Send**.

You should receive your subscription details in the response. Once this works, you can start exploring other endpoints like **Backlinks**, **Keyword Research**, **Domain Analysis** (including AI-Overview endpoints), or the Project endpoints (projects, ranks, audits, competitors) — all reachable with the same key.

### **Troubleshooting**

| Error | What it means | How to fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "incorrect token" | The API key is wrong | Re-check the key or contact api@seranking.com |
| 429 Too Many Requests | Too many requests (limit: 10 per second) | Contact api@seranking.com if you need higher limits |
| License expired | Trial ended or subscription inactive | Renew or update the plan in your dashboard |
| body response error | Request format is incorrect | Compare your request with the API documentation |
| "Your plan does not include API credits" | Your current plan or balance has no Data API credits | Upgrade to a plan that includes Data API credits, or top up your balance, then retry. If credits should already be included, contact api@seranking.com |

### **More Resources**

For additional help, please send an email to api@seranking.com.

## **Getting started**

Before you start, you'll need three things:

1. **A Claude account**.
2. **SE Ranking API access**. You’ll need API credits to pull data into Claude.
3. **A GA4 property** that you have viewer access to (or higher).

***No SE Ranking account yet?** Start a free 14-day trial.

## **Step 1: Connect SE Ranking to Claude**

In this step, you'll add SE Ranking as a custom connector in Claude. Once it's connected, Claude can pull live data directly from your account.

1. In Claude, open **Customize** > **Connectors**.
2. Click the **+** button and choose **Add custom connector**.
3. Fill in the details:
   * **Name:** SE Ranking
   * **Remote MCP server URL:** https://api.seranking.com/mcp
4. Click **Add**. SE Ranking will now show up under **Not connected**.
5. Click **SE Ranking** and then **Connect** to sign in and authorize.

That's it. Claude can now access your SE Ranking data.

**Prefer ChatGPT?** SE Ranking is also available as an official connector in ChatGPT. In ChatGPT, go to **Apps → Search apps → SE Ranking → Connect**, or open it directly at the SE Ranking ChatGPT connector.
